title_en: I Lost My Mind Over a Pretty Girl
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Dialect forms such as 'речит', 'заш/зш' (why), 'страмев' are Ohrid-area speech; 'з' едно' I read as 'with/over one', and 'милувал' as courting rather than literal caressing, my reading.

words_to_learn.en: I was ashamed, I was shy

lines.cyr: - Од умот се поизгубив з' едно лично девојче,
lines.lat: - Od umot se poizgubiv z' edno lično devojče,
lines.en: - I lost my mind over one pretty girl,

lines.cyr: па се страмев, па се срамев да ѝ речам.
lines.lat: pa se stramev, pa se sramev da ì rečam.
lines.en: but I was shy, I was ashamed to tell her.

lines.cyr: Оди мајко проговори, скришем, скришем да ѝ речиш,
lines.lat: Odi majko progovori, skrišem, skrišem da ì rečiš,
lines.en: Go, mother, speak to her, secretly, secretly tell her,

lines.cyr: скришем, скришем, скришем, скришем да ѝ речиш.
lines.lat: skrišem, skrišem, skrišem, skrišem da ì rečiš.
lines.en: secretly, secretly, secretly, secretly tell her.

lines.cyr: - Збогум синко, мили синко, јас ќе одам да ѝ речам.
lines.lat: - Zbogum sinko, mili sinko, jas ḱe odam da ì rečam.
lines.en: - Farewell, son, dear son, I will go to tell her.

lines.cyr: - Дал бог добро, дал бог добро стара мајко.
lines.lat: - Dal bog dobro, dal bog dobro stara majko.
lines.en: - God give you good, God give you good, old mother.

lines.cyr: - Син ми ќерко те милувал па се срамел да ти речит,
lines.lat: - Sin mi ḱerko te miluval pa se sramel da ti rečit,
lines.en: - My son, daughter, was courting you but was shy to tell you,
my son, daughter, was courting you,

lines.cyr: па се срамел, па се страмел да ти речит.
lines.lat: pa se sramel, pa se stramel da ti rečit.
lines.en: but he was shy, he was ashamed to tell you.

lines.cyr: - Кога син ти ме милувал, заш не казал од порано?
lines.lat: - Koga sin ti me miluval, zaš ne kazal od porano?
lines.en: - When your son was courting me, why didn't he say so earlier?
When your son was courting me,

lines.cyr: з'ш не кажал, з'ш не кажал од порано?
lines.lat: z'š ne kažal, z'š ne kažal od porano?
lines.en: why didn't he say, why didn't he say so earlier?

lines.cyr: Сега си сум посвршено з' едно лично ергенче,
lines.lat: Sega si sum posvršeno z' edno lično ergenče,
lines.en: Now I am engaged to a pretty young man,

lines.cyr: за едно лично, з'едно лично охриѓанче.
lines.lat: za edno lično, z'edno lično ohriǵanče.
lines.en: to a pretty, a pretty young man from Ohrid.
